overview: ICP Value Tracker is a personal portfolio tool for long-term ICP investors. Track your holdings, live price with 24h high/low, fear & greed + social trending, exit strategy planning, ICP news feed, and execution history — all tied to your Internet Identity login.
features: Live ICP price with 24h High/Low, source label, and 60-second auto-refresh
Investment Tracker split into 3 full-width card sections
Social Trending score card alongside Fear & Greed gauge
ICP News feed tab with live articles from crypto news APIs
Exit Strategy planner with price targets, executed button, and notification alerts
Historical Data tab with market metrics and execution history
Dark/light mode toggle and customizable refresh interval in Settings
Per-user data stored via Internet Identity login
